newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich sees getting votes for budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich sees getting votes for budget amendment.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich predicted Tuesday that there would be enough votes in the House to pass the balanced budget amendment.
"I think we'll have the votes by the time we get to the amendment," Gingrich told reporters, implicitly acknowledging that members still had to be persuaded.

Gingrich said that as members returned to their districts and heard constituents' concerns, "I think you're going to find members deciding again and again they want to be in favor of requiring a balanced budget."
Gingrich was speaking following a meeting in his office with House and Senate Republican leaders.
